title: We built a completely free stock analysis app with macro regime analysis, SEC fundamentals and options tools
author: Certain_Ad_9824
selftext:
We've spent more than six months building **Blue Eagle**, a Windows app for in-depth stock research: company fundamentals, quantitative analysis, macro regimes and options, all connected in one place. **The app and the research datasets we provide are completely free.**

I'm one of the people behind it. A lot of our work has gone into the analysis and data processing behind the interface. Here's what it includes:

* **Macro regime and sector analysis:** we maintain and update data for more than 40 economic indicators, including ISM surveys, inflation, employment and interest rates. Our models use this data to estimate the current economic regime and assess which sectors the backdrop supports or weighs on. You can explore the inputs, historical context and model confidence.
* **An intelligent SEC EDGAR reader:** research US-listed companies through income statements, balance sheets, cash flows and valuation metrics. We've put particular work into handling different reporting periods, restatements and earnings releases that arrive before the structured quarterly filing. Preliminary figures are labelled, and filed financial data takes priority when available. Historical coverage varies by company and metric.
* **Quantitative research data, supplied by us:** use our provided stock datasets for screening and quantitative work. We update these datasets weekly, and they're included completely free.
* **Compare stocks:** put companies side by side to compare fundamentals, growth, valuation, risk and price performance. For larger groups, use a sortable comparison table with up to 50 stocks.
* **Screen and organise research:** filter and rank companies, create watchlists and keep your research organised.
* **Develop trade ideas:** follow candidates, record your thesis and track catalysts as an idea develops into a position.
* **Analyse options:** visualise payoff diagrams, break-even prices and potential gains and losses at expiration.
* **Track your portfolio:** review holdings, performance, risk and how your positions fit the macro backdrop.

**…and much more.**

**Blue Eagle is completely free to use, including the macro data and weekly quantitative datasets we provide.** It runs on Windows and supports English and German.

Website: [https://blue-eagle.app/](https://blue-eagle.app/)
